meta.source: big-five-data (github.com/automoto/big-five-data): IPIP-NEO-300–derived public sample; trait scores 0–1.
meta.scale_mapping: In-app 1–5 norms: mean_15 = 1 + 4 * mean_01, std_15 = 4 * std_01 (linear stretch from dataset scale).
meta.instrument_note: Sample used full IPIP-NEO-300; app uses IPIP 50-item markers — interpret percentiles as approximate.
